About: Every number README.md quotes, in one place, and the recorded |S11| of every shipped run at every frequency of its sweep (S11_dB, from StartGHz in steps of StepMHz). LoopSensorExampleTests checks that the README quotes each Readme string and that each quoted dip is its run's recorded minimum; its Category=Benchmark tests re-run every shipped run, one test per solver, and hold every |S11| to RegressionToleranceDb. Measured once on an Apple M4 (10 cores, 16 GB), macOS 27.2, Palace 0.18.1 on 10 processes, Gmsh 4.15.2, EMerge 3.0.0, openEMS 0.37.0. A time is the whole run's wall clock; a size is the run's own tetrahedron or cell count.
